verdict.rationale: Intuit publishes an official QuickBooks Online MCP server under its own GitHub org, offering 145 tools with full CRUD across 29 entity types and 11 financial reports. Its README documents sandbox/production configuration, write and update disable toggles, and tool-category restriction, and a probe confirms an official MCP docs page on developer.intuit.com. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that agents connect and work reliably in practice.
